name: Soundside
description: MCP-native AI media generation across multiple providers — images, video, audio, music, editing, composition and analysis, plus LoRA adapter training. 19 MCP tools, priced per call in USDC on Base with no account.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No account needed on the x402 path; an API key with credits is the alternative. Live per-tool pricing and x402 status: https://mcp.soundside.ai/api/x402/status — it reports enabled:true, network eip155:8453, USDC, Coinbase CDP facilitator, and prices per tool/provider (e.g. analyze_media $0.03). Pricing is ceiling-quote: the amount in the 402 is the exact charge. The operator marks the x402 lane BETA and says the tool surface will expand.
